brief:
With libraries, schools and homes destroyed across Gaza, surviving books have become cherished possessions for residents navigating the devastation. Al Jazeera English reported that the loss of educational and cultural institutions has made individual volumes rare and valued items within communities facing widespread displacement and material loss.

The preservation of books in Gaza reflects broader efforts to maintain cultural continuity and knowledge amid ongoing conflict. Residents have worked to protect surviving texts as symbols of resilience and connection to intellectual life before the destruction of institutional collections.
dek: With libraries, schools and homes destroyed in Gaza, surviving books have become treasured possessions.
title: Gazans treasure surviving books amid destruction of libraries and homes
